commits.message: Persist the run queue to disk so a restart resumes in-flight jobs

pull_requests.title: Durable run queue: resume in-flight jobs after a restart
pull_requests.description: Persists the run queue to disk so a crash or restart resumes jobs instead of dropping them. Closes #38.

pull_requests.title: Distributed lock via the database for multi-node scheduling
pull_requests.description: Attempt at a DB-backed advisory lock so several scheduler nodes can run without double-dispatching a job. References #39.

review_comments.body: The DB lock adds a round-trip on every dispatch and couples scheduling to database availability — is that the tradeoff we want before we have real multi-node load?
Fair. Holding off — the single-node path is fine for now and a lease-based approach may fit better later.

linked_issues.title: Support multiple scheduler nodes without double-dispatch
